title: Color Picker
description: A curated palette first, any color second — swatches for the 95% case, a native picker for the rest.
a11y: Swatches are buttons with role=radio inside a labelled radiogroup, with one tab stop. Arrow keys move and select (horizontal arrows follow visual direction; in RTL, Left moves forward), Home and End jump to the ends, and Enter or Space selects. Focus on the selected swatch adds an outline outside its selection ring, so both states stay visible. The custom tile is a native color input: it previews while the picker moves and notifies once on change. There is no drag handle. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
